items.title: Jindal Poly AGM: FY26 audit qualified over JPFL Films fire inventory valuation
items.text: At its 52nd AGM on 30 Sep 2026, Jindal Poly Films shareholders adopted the FY2026 accounts. Auditors issued a modified opinion on the consolidated results because damaged inventory at subsidiary JPFL Films could not be fully valued after the fire, as physical verification was still ongoing. Management said the qualification has no material financial impact. JPFL Films is the unit behind the Rs 250 cr capacitor-film doubling plan, so the fire and audit uncertainty remain a governance and execution overhang for that thesis.
